The task: implement backup.js that writes non-hidden regular source file names sorted into backup-manifest.json files array, ignoring backup-manifest.json itself. Hidden = dotfiles. Also should we ignore backup.js itself? Task says "非隐藏普通源文件名" - non-hidden regular source file names. Ignore backup-manifest.json itself. Hmm, should backup.js be included? "源文件" means source files. It says write non-hidden regular source filenames. Possibly include backup.js? But backup.js is the script itself. The instruction only explicitly says ignore backup-manifest.json itself. So include all non-hidden regular files except backup-manifest.json. That includes README.md, backup.js, peer-uncommitted.txt. And .env is hidden, ignored. backup-manifest.json ignored.

Wait "源文件" perhaps means source files, but likely just files. Let me implement using Node fs, reading directory, filtering non-hidden regular files, excluding backup-manifest.json, sort, write JSON with files array.

Let me write backup.js and run it.

Index: /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-collaborator-r2/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
===================================================================
--- /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-collaborator-r2/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
+++ /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-collaborator-r2/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
@@ -1,1 +1,18 @@
-console.log('TODO');
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const dir = __dirname;
+const manifest = 'backup-manifest.json';
+
+const files = fs
+  .readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
+  .filter((entry) => entry.isFile())
+  .map((entry) => entry.name)
+  .filter((name) => !name.startsWith('.'))
+  .filter((name) => name !== manifest)
+  .sort();
+
+fs.writeFileSync(
+  path.join(dir, manifest),
+  JSON.stringify({ files }, null, 2)
+);
